note: Adjudicator input for amendment 1.1.0 (written after reading the retrieved SEC documents; the rule was frozen before, see protocol-amendment-1.1.0.json). crash_adjudicate.py verifies every quote in the cached SEC bytes, the windows (privately, against provider dates), the caScan dispositions and the provider split condition, and writes crash-adjudication-1.1.0.json. Jumps are addressed by their order within the chain (1 = first unresolved jump).
clarification: E1 is read strictly: the reported event must not post-date the jump day (an event after J cannot explain the move); a filing in [J-14d, J+7d] may report an event dated up to J. Stricter than the literal wording; disclosed here, decided before writing the decisions below, affects GRDI jump 2 only.

dispositionCategories.CONTRACT_OR_PLAN_ADJUSTMENT_CLAUSE: generic adjustment clause of a merger agreement, equity plan, warrant, note or credit agreement; no corporate action announced
dispositionCategories.HISTORICAL_OTHER_DATE: corporate action with a stated date far outside +/-5 trading days of the jump
dispositionCategories.CONDITIONAL_INTENTION_NOT_EFFECTED: stated possibility/intention; no filing in the window reports it as effected
dispositionCategories.PLAN_TERM_FUTURE: term of a restructuring support agreement or plan of reorganization for creditors, to occur on a future effective date
dispositionCategories.DOCUMENTED_CA_USED: the corporate action that the class-B decision applies, or one handled by a provider split factor on its own date
dispositionCategories.CHAIN_CLASS_C: chain stays CA_UNRESOLVED; hit not individually adjudicated
